Name: Mikloth, Ruler of Second Course
Summary: Ruler of the second month's course, with Dodai the Ahohite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:4: Ruler of the second month's course, with Dodai the Ahohite.
LifeLesson: The mention of Mikloth in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
